about: state-upper contests of 2023 in New Jersey, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/nj_sos.py's cache (the Division of Elections' Official Lists; MEDSL holds no 2023).

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

nj_sos.name: New Jersey Division of Elections, Official Lists of the General Election of 2023-11-07: State Senate and General Assembly
nj_sos.licence: no licence printed; the New Jersey Division of Elections' official election returns, public records
nj_sos.note: the Official Lists of the State Senate and General Assembly, read by pipeline/intake/nj_sos.py: general-assembly: https://www.nj.gov/state/elections/assets/pdf/election-results/2023/2023-official-general-results-general-assembly.pdf (sha256 14233136941a83f3, 40 contests, 160 candidates); state-senate: https://www.nj.gov/state/elections/assets/pdf/election-results/2023/2023-official-general-results-state-senate.pdf (sha256 cdd339ba234c0374, 40 contests, 86 candidates).
